title: A headless run can push the integration history to any branch or remote with kbgit.py sync --push --branch B --remote R
goal: when KB_HEADLESS_RUNNER is set, `kbgit.py sync` refuses `--remote` and `--branch` (it pushes to the integration remote's main and the code/<id> lane branches only), exit 2 with the cause named and nothing pushed; planted-failure tests run `--push --branch scratch` and `--remote <second bare>` with the variable set (refused) and without it (unchanged); the public remote is already refused by the private-history rule; found by the SP-itmjxudu review

run: set -e; d=$(mktemp -d); git clone -q "$PWD" "$d/r"; cd "$d/r"; if KB_HEADLESS_RUNNER=1 python3 _tools/kbgit.py sync --push --dry-run --branch scratch >/dev/null 2>&1; then exit 1; fi
